summary: This paper presents a definitive resolution of three major theoretical and algorithmic bottlenecks in the unified Dicke-based asymptotic quantum many-body scar (AQMBS) state preparation framework of Asari et al. [1]. By deriving exact rational without-replacement fourth and sixth moments of Z(l) over Dicke states across all four cosine-sum resonance classes, the author sharpens kurtosis bounds by 4× to 8× and eliminates loose Hoeffding relaxations. Furthermore, by optimizing the linear projection factor in block-encoded infidelity estimation, the work establishes tight non-asymptotic infidelity bounds and certifies single-round Grover amplification with zero overshoot. Finally, the introduction of a collision-free MSB-to-LSB binary-shift reversible routing circuit reduces the circuit complexity from O(M^2) to O(M log^2 n), achieving permanent crossover against displacement lower bounds in the fault-tolerant regime. All algebraic cores are fully formalized and verified in Lean 4 with zero sorry and audited via an AST-verified zero-float Python verification suite.
weaknesses: The MSB-to-LSB decreasing-p sweep in Stage 2 cannot be parallelized to polylogarithmic depth due to serial dependency chains among adjacent bits, requiring further investigation for optimal circuit depth trade-offs.
